_about: Model-free word swaps (round 10), read by humanizer.lexicon_edit. Key: lemma|UPOS. A word a curated table in humanizer.py owns (AI_WORDS, PLAIN_WORDS, EVERYDAY_SWAPS, AI_FAVOURITES) is not listed here: that table decides it. 'rules' are tried in order; the first whose conditions all hold gives the options ('use', lemmas; the first word is inflected like the original; an empty 'use' keeps the word). Conditions: object (lemmas | 'any' | 'none'; every item of a listed object must match), object_not, object_not_pron, object_tag_not, head / head_not (the noun an adjective describes, the word an adverb modifies), head_pos / head_tag, head_not_dep / head_not_tag, no_det_on_head, subject / subject_not, subject_not_propn, need_subject, no_subject, dep / dep_not, tags, tones, child (a dependency that must be present), child_tag, child_not, child_any, child_word, child_prep, child_prep_not, child_wh, child_mark, prep (a preposition or particle child that must be present), prep_not, prt_not, prep_any, pobj_class, pobj_plain, not_after / not_before / prev_tag (neighbouring words), next, next_num, next_num_or_fraction, next2_proper, with_next (the next word, dropped by the swap: 'lead to' -> 'cause'), position (first | not_first | last | after_head), aux_have, aux_will, aux_not, no_neg_head, attr_det, attr_plain, det_in / det_not, need_det, acomp_in, no_compound, no_reduced_relative. A list item 'class:person' etc. matches nouns of that kind. 'off': tones the entry never applies in. 'never': sentences where the word must stay (tests). 'examples': sentences where it changes (tests).
